overview.purpose_zh: 这张瀑布图把九月到十月的收入变化拆成四项：新客户、扩展、流失和折扣，让人看到每一笔各自加了多少或减了多少。
works_zh: 解释一个月或一个季度的收入为什么上升或下降
把总变化拆成可以逐项讨论的来源
分清哪些项目在增加收入、哪些在流失收入
uses_zh: 管理层例会上的收入说明

understanding.read_zh: 先看最左和最右两根柱子，确认起点和终点；中间每一根都从上一根结束的位置接上去，向上是增加，向下是减少。

elements.note_zh: 最左边的柱子，代表上个月的收入水平。
从上一根柱子顶部向上延伸，长度就是增加的量。
向下延伸，长度就是减少的量。
最右边的柱子，是起点加上所有增减后的结果。

look_for_zh: 首尾两根柱子之间差了多少

observations.en: Revenue rose from 320 to 415 between September and October, a net gain of 95.
observations.zh: 收入从九月的 320 升到十月的 415，净增 95。

observations.en: New customers were the largest positive driver, adding 110.
observations.zh: 新客户是最大的正向因素，带来 110。

observations.en: Churn removed 38, the largest drag, while discounts removed 22.
observations.zh: 流失带走了 38，是最大的拖累；折扣又带走了 22。

observations.en: Expansion added 45, more than churn took away.
observations.zh: 扩展增加了 45，比流失带走的还多。

describe.en: Revenue started September at 320 and finished October at 415.
describe.zh: 收入在九月起点是 320，十月终点是 415。
alternatives: The company's revenue moved from 320 to 415 between September and October.
Monthly revenue stood at 320 in September and 415 in October.
describe.note_zh: 先说起点和终点，再解释中间四项，听众不会迷路。

describe.en: Revenue grew from 320 to 415 in one month, a growth rate of about 30 percent.
describe.zh: 收入一个月里从 320 增长到 415，增长率约为 30%。
alternatives: The month-on-month growth rate was about 30 percent.
Revenue rose 95, a gain of about 30 percent on September.
describe.note_zh: 说增长率一定要带周期：这里是月增长，不是年增长。

describe.en: New customers increased revenue by 110 during the month.
describe.zh: 新客户在这个月让收入增加了 110。
alternatives: New customers added 110 to the total.
There was an increase of 110 from new customers.
describe.note_zh: by 后面是差值，不是终点；110 是这一项自己的贡献。

describe.en: Revenue increased from 320 in September to 415 in October.
describe.zh: 收入从九月的 320 增长到十月的 415。
describe.pattern: increase from + starting value + to + ending value
describe.note_zh: from ... to ... 同时给出两个端点，适合放在段首做总述。

describe.en: Churn pulled revenue down by 38, and discounts took away another 22.
describe.zh: 流失把收入拉低了 38，折扣又带走了 22。
alternatives: Revenue fell by 38 through churn and by 22 through discounts.
Churn and discounts removed 38 and 22 respectively.
describe.note_zh: 下降项要保留方向词：took away、removed、pulled down，别写成 added。

describe.en: New customers added 110, higher than expansion at 45.
describe.zh: 新客户带来 110，高于扩展的 45。
alternatives: The gain from new customers, 110, was well above the 45 from expansion.
Expansion brought 45, lower than the 110 from new customers.
describe.note_zh: 两个正向项也可以互相比较，突出主次。

describe.en: The chart breaks the 95 increase down into two gains and two losses.
describe.zh: 这张图把 95 的增长拆成两项增加和两项减少。
alternatives: The waterfall splits the 95 net change into four items.
The four bars explain the gap between 320 and 415.
describe.note_zh: break down 强调把一个总数拆成部分，适合开场一句。

academic.en: The waterfall chart traces monthly revenue from 320 in September to 415 in October, a net increase of 95. Two items add to the total: new customers contribute 110 and expansion contributes 45. Two items reduce it: churn subtracts 38 and discounts subtract 22. The positive drivers together exceed the negative ones, so the closing balance is higher than the opening balance. The largest single movement is attributed to new customers, while churn is the largest negative item, at 38 against 22 for discounts.
academic.zh: 这张瀑布图记录月度收入从九月的 320 到十月的 415，净增 95。有两个项目让总额上升：新客户贡献 110，扩展贡献 45。有两个项目让总额下降：流失减少 38，折扣减少 22。正向因素合计大于负向因素，因此期末总额高于期初。单项最大变化来自新客户；最大的负向项目是流失，为 38，而折扣为 22。

business.en: Our revenue closed October at 415, up 95 from September's 320, so we grew by about 30 percent. New customers did the heavy lifting, adding 110, and expansion added a further 45. The offsetting story is retention: churn removed 38, more than discounts at 22, which makes keeping existing accounts our clearest lever for next month. This bridge shows growth that is real but partly paid for. We should put our next month's effort behind retention before we chase more new customers.
business.zh: 我们的收入在十月收于 415，比九月的 320 高出 95，约增长 30%。主力是新客户，贡献 110，扩展又加了 45。抵消这部分的是留存问题：流失拿走 38，多于折扣的 22，因此保住现有客户是我们下个月最明确的抓手。这张桥图显示增长是真实的，但有代价。下个月我们应先把精力放在留存上，再去争取更多新客户。

simple.en: Revenue was 320 in September and 415 in October. That is 95 more. New customers brought in 110. Expansion added 45. Churn took away 38. Discounts took away 22. The gains were bigger than the losses, so the month ended higher than it started. Keeping customers is the biggest job, because churn was the largest loss.
simple.zh: 九月收入是 320，十月是 415，多了 95。新客户带来 110，扩展增加 45。流失拿走 38，折扣拿走 22。增加的部分比减少的部分大，所以这个月结束时比开始时高。留住客户是最重要的工作，因为流失是最大的一笔损失。

language_notes.body_zh: by 后面跟变化量，to 后面跟终点值。图里收入增加 95，是从 320 到 415；写 increase by 95 和 increase to 415 都对，但意思不同。
首尾两根是总数，中间四根是解释项。总数只出现两次，不要把四项增减也当成新的收入水平。
examples: September at 320 and October at 415 are totals.
New customers, expansion, churn and discounts are the drivers.

language_notes.body_zh: drag 指把总数往下拉的那一项，商务里常用来点出最大的负面因素；最大的一项说 the largest drag，小额的那项说 the smaller drag。
examples: Churn was the largest drag at 38.
Discounts were the smaller drag at 22.
